column1: # The licence names a Debian copyright file (DEP-5) writes, and the SPDX id
# each stands for in licences.tsv (LICENSE-001); tool/check_bundle_licences.js
# reads the copyright files a Linux package carries through it. A name not
# listed fails. Columns: the name, its SPDX id, and for a row only one
# package's file may use, that package, the exact Files: of the stanzas it
# covers (empty: any of that package's), and why. A row with files covers a
# stanza only when it lists every file of it, so a licence that also names a
# file of the library falls back to the generic row.
